title: A shop Asha has never paid before
story: ShopBot finds a cheaper grocer, GreenBasket, that Asha has never used, for a INR 2,500 order. The cart matches what she asked for, but the Guard steps up with MERCHANT_NEW. Fake and look-alike shops are a common scam, so a quick confirmation the first time is cheap insurance. Asha approves, and ShopBot pays.

steps.instruction: Order fruit and vegetables for the week, wherever's cheapest.
steps.item: Fruit and vegetables for the week: bananas, apples, tomatoes, onions, spinach

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order fruit and vegetables for the week, wherever's cheapest.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: GreenBasket has them for INR 2,500, cheaper than FreshMart. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The cart matches. Asking AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: You've never paid GreenBasket before, so I've sent this to your phone to approve.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Asha approved. Checking the approval before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

what_to_notice: MERCHANT_NEW is the only reason: the cart matched and INR 2,500 is under the INR 5,000 "ask me" line. The rule only applies from the medium tier (INR 2,000) up, so a small first order at a new shop would have been let through. Next time ShopBot pays GreenBasket, it won't be new.
